sourceText:
Bourbon Turkey
By: Yuna Wu
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:06pm

Ingredients




1 cup dry red wine
1/2 cup bourbon
1/2 cup dry sherry
1/2 cup soy sauce
3 tablespoons vegetable oil
2 tablespoons sugar
5 whole star anise
1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger
freshly ground black pepper, to taste

1 1/4 cups bourbon
2/3 cup honey
2/3 cup ketchup
1/4 cup (packed) brown sugar

Preparation

1 Have the turkey cut up as follows: drumsticks removed and cut crosswise through the bone; thighs removed and halved through the bone; breast removed (left on the bone) and each half cut into four or five pieces; and wings cut at elbows, tips discarded. 2 Reserve the backs for another use. 3 Rinse the pieces well and pat dry. 4 Stir all the marinade ingredients (the first 9 ingredients) together in a large bowl. 5 Add the turkey pieces and coat them in the mixture. 6 Cover and marinate for 1 hour. 7 Preheat the oven to 325 F. 8 Lift the turkey pieces from the marinade, and arrange them in one or two roasting pans. 9 Pour 1/2 cup of the marinade (or 1 cup if using two pans) over the turkey. 10 Bake for 1 hour, turning and basting the pieces every 20 minutes. (If you are using two pans, rotate them over 30 minutes.) Increase the oven temperature to 450 F. 11 Stir the glaze ingredients together in a bowl (the last four ingredients). 12 Brush the turkey well with the glaze, and bake 30 minutes, brushing and turning every 5 minutes. (If you are using two pans, rotate them after 15 minutes.) 13 Mound the turkey on a large platter, and serve.
